coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 10 of 17 ground-truth variable items (59%): chronological data splits, input window size, forecast horizon, cycle length, model type, input/output dimensions, synthetic-data parameters, data normalization, MSE, and MAE.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses AdamW rather than the specified Adam configuration and CPU resources rather than an RTX 4090. Omits the RevIN flag, specified epoch and batch-size settings, cycle-index generation method, and training-loss or learned-cycle visualizations. Period estimation is not equivalent to cycle-index generation.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to state that a trained CycleNet accurately forecasts future time-series values and provides visualizations of historical data, ground truth, predictions, and learned cyclic patterns.
